mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.1% signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS on 20-day returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or average 20-day returns in declining rate periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 7.5%, it triggers expectations of aggressive monetary policy response, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 5-day returns in UNRATE > 7.5% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 3-month averages signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect between HOUST and RSAFS on 60-day returns is not significant (p > 0.05) or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, rising industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 indicates sustained economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day returns in late-cycle expansion with INDPRO > 100 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC in this regime falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 950.0 thousand units, it signals strong housing market activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 5-day returns in HOUST > 950.0 periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP growth (GDPC1) above 3-month averages signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect between INDPRO and GDPC1 on 60-day returns is not significant (p > 0.05) or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment recovery regimes, monthly payroll growth exceeding 100,000 signals accelerating labor market improvement, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day returns in high unemployment recovery with PAYEMS > 100,000 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC in this regime falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation below 2.0% signals stable price conditions that support equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 5-day returns in CPIAUCSL < 2.0% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
